provenance: Repo-local descriptor (the publisher's own repo). Context and the allowed backends come from the repo's litertlm_manifest.json (it lists gpu and cpu for the int4 and int4_1loop files and cpu for the int8 file; the int4 and int4_1loop variants get a gpu profile only, see below). A looped normalized-GPT reasoning model (NVIDIA's Dory1.0-4B; its 20 recurrent attention/MLP pairs run twice per token in the int4 and int8 files and once in the int4_1loop file): the bundle declares the thought channel (<think> / </think>) and its generation prompt opens it (<think> then a newline), so the model reasons from its first token; with thinking off the template closes the block at once (<think></think>). handler_config.channels spells the bundle's channel and thinking_default is true. The bundle's KV budget is 2,048 tokens for prompt and reply together. int4 is the GPU file and int8 the CPU file, as the card says (on a CPU the int4 file is the wrong choice): int4 has a gpu profile only and int8 a cpu profile only, so on a phone whose GPU path does not load the model (none of the GPU builds the publisher ran fitted the 8 GB Pixel 8a, and the int4 file itself was not run there, the card) the app requests variant int8 itself, ModelRef(id, variant = "int8"): Auto never switches variants. int4_1loop is the trade NVIDIA's card describes (how many times the shared block runs trades compute for accuracy, with no retraining and no model swap): the int4 file's weights, embedding, tokenizer and LlmMetadata section byte for byte, in a graph that runs the 20 pairs once per token (36 KV caches instead of 56). The publisher measured it on one Galaxy S26's GPU at 17.32 tok/s decode and 439.6 prefill against the int4 file's 11.08 and 274.5, in runs that alternated the two (LiteRT-LM v0.18.0, 2026-10-23), and on GSM8K (Mac GPU, thinking off) at 86 of 100 against the int4 file's 90 (the card). Like int4 it has a gpu profile only; an app asks for it with ModelRef(id, variant = "int4_1loop"). The pin is ff0f6e32 (main on 2026-10-23), the last of the three commits that added the int4_1loop file, its card section and its manifest entry; the int4 and int8 files are the same bytes as at 61cb6bbe, the previous pin. The repo's manifest sets min_runtime_version 0.18.0 for all three files: the earliest runtime the publisher verified them on (they were also packed with that builder version), not a floor the runtime enforces. runtime_range starts at 0.16.1, the runtime this SDK links; the run below shows that runtime loading and answering with the int4 and int8 files; int4_1loop has not run on it yet. On 2026-10-22 a Galaxy S26 (SM-S942Q, Android 16) ran the int4 and int8 variants on litertlm-android 0.16.1 in samples/chat's ChatDeviceCheck at this repository's commit 5e497ba, the files downloaded from the Hub (at 61cb6bbe) on the phone: int4 on the GPU answered 17 + 25 with "42" and the model card's "Extract the dates from: The meeting moved from May 3 to May 17." with "May 3, May 17" (thinking on, each thought closed, after 369 and 1,939 characters of reasoning, 107 and 565 tokens by the model's tokenizer; the runtime put every node of the prefill and decode graphs on its GPU delegate), and int8 on the CPU answered "42" (480 characters of thought, 137 tokens). No profile has a gate run or a verification record.
